summary: VERIFIED root cause of the fatal banner — two independent pack defects in internal/stream/pack.go: (a) tail-phase ffmpeg invocations (packTailArgs, renditionArgs seek=true) set no -hls_list_size, so the ffmpeg default window of 5 truncates the tail playlist that mergePlaylists publishes as the complete ENDLIST build — all pre-window tail segments unreachable and the playlist duration wrong; (b) variantLayout prefixes rendition tail refs t/rendN/ while moveTree publishes tail artifacts at final/t/rendN/ and the merge is written into final/rendN/, so every rendition tail ref (incl. the EXT-X-MAP init URI) resolves to final/rendN/t/rendN/... which does not exist — serve.go joins strictly and 404s (live-verified: rend0/t/rend0/seg-00169.m4s -> 404 while t/rend0/seg-00169.m4s -> 200). hls.js hits the 404 at the head/tail discontinuity and Player.tsx shows the fatal banner. Single-audio builds are silently truncated the same way (131 listed vs 159 on disk, no 404 — no banner, wrong duration, unreachable middle). publishHeadOnly legacy branch strands segments for whole-file-within-head-chunk items (backlog row 1). Repro: internal/stream/pack_repro_tail_window_test.go FAILS on current code (untracked file; becomes the fix first probe).
next: Fix shape (planner owns the design): pin -hls_list_size 0 on both tail-phase arg builders; fix the rendition tail URI base so refs written into final/rendN/index.m3u8 resolve to final/t/rendN/; unify publishHeadOnly so the legacy single-variant branch moves segments too; design the repack story for already-published broken builds (existing items sit at state complete, so POST play retry will not re-enqueue them); then the web-only symptom 2 — poster on the Player video element from the frame-grabber thumb, drop the separate video-lane thumbnail section so the episode page shows only the player.
findings: go.log is structurally silent on media routes — segment 404s leave no server-side trace; verification must rely on probes, not server logs
playback_progress stayed empty despite the play session — fatal landed before the first >=5s drift report, and Player progress-PUT failures are swallowed silently
repacks accumulate build dirs (a fresh nonce per pack, 2+ nonces per repacked item) — no GC of stale builds
no prior test asserted that playlist-referenced segments exist at playlist-relative paths or that listed count equals published count — the coverage gap that let both defects ship green
